title: TUI: multi-project layer — project discovery, registry, ordering
description: Projects appear as a level above epics in the tree. Decisions (per user): (1) discover projects by scanning ~/repos for .pebbles/ directories, unless a config lists other directories to search; (2) sort projects by modification time of their .pebbles/index.json, most recent first. Open design points: config file location/format (candidate: ~/.config/pebbles/projects.toml), project switching keys, whether the CLI needs a companion command (pebbles projects list). SPEC: needs r[project-registry] and r[tui-*] rules when implemented; the detail pane should surface each issue's SPEC rule references (r[impl]/r[verify]) so the TUI supports the project's spec+design approach.
